preconditions.expression: all(c in '0123456789abcdef' for c in stdin)
preconditions.description: The input string consists only of hexadecimal digits.
The input string has a length of at most 14.
The input string contains at least one non-zero digit.

postconditions.expression: stdout == 'NO' or (len(stdout) == len(stdin) and all(c in '0123456789abcdef' for c in stdout))
postconditions.description: The output is either 'NO' or a hexadecimal string of the same length as the input.
If the output is not 'NO', it is a permutation of the input string.

postconditions.expression: stdout == 'NO' or (int(stdout, 16) == min(int(''.join(p), 16) for p in permutations(stdin) if int(''.join(p), 16) >= int(stdin, 16)))
postconditions.description: If the output is not 'NO', it is the smallest possible numerical value of a permutation of the input string that is greater than or equal to the input string's numerical value.
